subject: english
question:
Directions: Each of the following sentences in this section has a blank space and is followed by four choices. Select the most appropriate choice to fill in the blank and mark your response accordingly.

She was moving slowly and _________ yesterday when she fell.
solution:
The correct answer is** '****shakily**.

**'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** blank requires an adverb** that describes the manner in which she was moving when she fell.
 
• **"Shakily" **indicates an unsteady or trembling movement, fitting the context.

Therefore, the** correct answer** is- **'Shakily'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2** "firmly" **and Option 4** "strongly"** imply confidence or strength, not suitable here.
 
• Option 3 **"vaguely"** means in a way that is uncertain, indefinite, or unclear, which doesn't fit the context.
